title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a compliant MCP server.
